name: soccer-fixtures-odds-math
title: Soccer Form, Fixtures & Odds-Screen API for Betting Agents
description: Soccer toolkit as an API: team form and head-to-head from real scorelines, fixtures and results for any day, bet settlement, one-call odds screening (de-vig, fair odds, EV, Kelly), parlay math. No API key. One tool call per run.

arguments.title: Arguments (JSON object of tool kwargs)
arguments.description: e.g. {"date": "2026-09-20", "league": "england.1"} — get_team_form takes {"team": "Bayern", "h2h_against": "Dortmund"}, screen_odds takes {"prices": [{"match": "...", "odds": 1.9, "probability": 0.55}]}, get_team_sentiment takes {"date": "...", "teams": ["Bayern"]}, settle_picks takes {"picks": [...], "date": "..."}, devig_market takes {"prices": [2.1, 3.4, 3.6]}
